authority: owner review of the 8/23 settlement, eight required corrections
r6: data/audit/2026-08-23_three_arm_settlement.json is NOT edited. Its measured values stand; this record corrects the INTERPRETATION written around them.
what_stands: every settlement VALUE is accepted as descriptive: the Brier, log loss, AUC, MAE, RMSE, signed bias, per-dose subgroups and the WNBA/NFL blocks are unchanged.

C1_wnba_null_was_wrong.what_I_wrote: a perfect AUC on n=4 happens about 4% of the time under a coin flip
C1_wnba_null_was_wrong.verdict: WRONG, and wrong by a factor of six in the direction that flattered the finding
C1_wnba_null_was_wrong.the_actual_shape: one home win, three away wins

correct_nulls.reading: these are different tests of different statistics on the same games; neither is a p-value for a model and neither becomes one by being small

C1_wnba_null_was_wrong.what_4_percent_actually_was: 1/24 = 4.17%, the probability of ONE SPECIFIC ORDERING of four items. That is not either test. P(perfect AUC | 1 positive, 3 negatives) = 1/C(4,1) = 25%. P(4-0 under a fair coin) = 1/16 = 6.25%. They are different statistics on the same games.
C1_wnba_null_was_wrong.root_cause: I quoted a null from memory instead of computing it. Under R1 a null quoted from memory is a fabricated number, exactly like a fabricated result.
C1_wnba_null_was_wrong.fix: evaluation_standard.auc_null_probability and directional_null_probability compute both exactly from the subgroup's own shape; 49/49 mutants, including one that reproduces the 1/24 error and is killed by a fixture.

C2_slope_cannot_authorize_widening.what_I_wrote: the challenger needs its offset widened, not re-regularised
C2_slope_cannot_authorize_widening.correct_status: HYPOTHESIS: probabilities may be too compressed
C2_slope_cannot_authorize_widening.why: a calibration slope from 15 games in ONE cluster is a descriptive, unstable estimate. Changing the model because of it is adapting to a settled outcome, which is precisely what the adaptive-layer governance exists to prevent — the offset is a SLOW-layer object and SLOW adapts only at a formal release against preregistered criteria.
C2_slope_cannot_authorize_widening.required_instead: register a WIDENING CHALLENGER prospectively as its own arm, with its own immutable evaluation_arm_id, and let it earn or lose the comparison forward.

C3_calibration_verdict_softened.why: NUMERICALLY_ESTIMABLE means the fit could be COMPUTED. It has never meant the sample can establish miscalibration, and that separation is the whole point of the Hessian rule. n=15 across a 12pp forecast range cannot establish it.

C4_champion_claim_was_mathematically_fal.what_I_wrote: +0.00076 is indistinguishable from zero at any sample size
C4_champion_claim_was_mathematically_fal.verdict: FALSE AS STATED. A small persistent effect becomes distinguishable with enough observations; 'at any sample size' asserts something arithmetic does not support.
C4_champion_claim_was_mathematically_fal.replacement: The observed improvement was negligible on this slate and is not inferentially evaluable.

C5_gates_separated.was: 0/100 NO_PROMOTE, quoted as if it were one gate

REAL_MONEY_AUTHORIZATION_GATE.requires: explicit human approval; no code path authorises it

C5_gates_separated.why: they are three different objects with three different owners. Collapsing them into one number lets progress on the model gate read as progress toward money, which is the exact confusion the wall exists to prevent.

C6_baseline_meant_three_things.verdict: ACCEPTED — 'baseline' named three different arms across two tables

identifiers_now_distinct.EXPANDING_HOME_PRIOR: winner estimand — the expanding Beta(10,10) home prior
identifiers_now_distinct.CHALLENGER_TOTAL: total estimand — the challenger's own total, which also occupied the baseline total column, identical in all 15 games
identifiers_now_distinct.EXPANDING_TOTAL_PRIOR: total estimand — the independent league-mean comparator

C6_baseline_meant_three_things.mechanical_guard: render_contract.arm_identity_gate refuses one label covering two arm identities and any label that does not name the arm it carries; 30/30 mutants.

lead_time.resolution: two different immutable instants were being quoted as one number. Both are real: the arms were registered at 2026-08-23T10:04:27Z and the card artifact was committed at 2026-08-23T10:22:21Z in 01a492e. First pitch 17:35:00Z.
lead_time.derivation: the LATEST pregame instant is the binding one, because prospectivity is only as strong as its weakest link: 17:35:00Z minus the 10:22:21Z artifact commit.
lead_time.arm_registration_lead: 7h30m33s, reported separately and never as the binding figure

tb_bal_was_not_a_blowout.was: the two games the challenger lost are the two where the away team won big
tb_bal_was_not_a_blowout.correct: TB beat BAL 3-1, a two-run game. Both losses were away wins, but only CHC 19-2 was a blowout. The home-lean story survives on direction; the word 'big' did not.

C8_wnba_is_diagnostic_only.status: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY — may be recorded, may not enter promotion evidence
C8_wnba_is_diagnostic_only.why: the champion's feature state is frozen at 2026-07-22, 32 days stale against a 21-day ceiling. The staleness that blocked its actions blocks its evidence too.
C8_wnba_is_diagnostic_only.source_attribution: OWNER_RELAY describes the ACQUISITION ROUTE, not the underlying authority. The tier-1 record must also identify the official results source. The owner stated 'MLB scoreboard', 'WNBA results' and 'NFL scoreboard', which names the class and not the artifact — recorded verbatim and flagged UNDERSPECIFIED rather than resolved to a specific host I did not see.

BINDING_CONCLUSION: On the August 23 slate, the expanding total prior had the lowest observed MAE and RMSE, while the MLB challenger had the lowest observed winner Brier and highest observed AUC. All comparisons are descriptive and non-decision-grade because the cohort contains one slate-date cluster. The calibration slope motivates a prospectively registered widening experiment but cannot authorize adaptation.
